what: A review round's copied context missed an entire new capture kind, and the existing drift warning stayed quiet. A round's context was copied from the previous one, and a new kind of screenshot capture landed in the same directory alongside the files the context already listed; the reviewer reported the new captures as still missing.
rule: A job that names one capture kind by directory glob should name every kind actually captured there, not just the first one noticed.
fix: Enforcement: `validate` warns when a job's `contextGlob` entries for one directory cover only some of that directory's filename prefixes, naming the covered prefixes and up to 5 uncovered files; declaring one `contextGlob` entry per prefix (multiple entries already work against the same directory) closes the gap. Documentation: manifest reference.
